bio_en: Falang was a sixth-century Chinese teacher of the Three Treatises tradition associated with Xinghuang Monastery. He received the teaching through Sengquan and transmitted it to Jizang. His place in the Sanlun lineage is preserved through accounts of his teaching and disciples rather than an extant work in the Chinese Buddhist canon.
bio_summary: 法朗承攝山三論之學，住建康興皇寺，弘《中論》《百論》《十二門論》。吉藏從之受學，遂集三論宗義之大成。

lineages.display_note: 本傳稱興皇道朗，依候選錄及 DILA A002918 規範為法朗；以本傳所載從學立師承。

evidence_refs.claim: 《續高僧傳》吉藏傳記其七歲投興皇朗法師出家，從受義學。
